opening.argument: This is an educational walkthrough of crypto learn-and-earn programs built around lessons, quizzes, and conditional rewards. It explains that viewers should “watch videos as you can see it says learn about basic crypto concepts and exchange features by watching short video,” then “complete quizzes as you can see it says put your newfound knowledge to the test by taking a simple quiz.” Although the program describes rewards for correct participation, the offer is expressly qualified: “Results are not guaranteed, and you may not earn any crypto.” Account creation includes an email address and password, but the available evidence identifies no payment requirement or misuse of that information. Those qualifications and the absence of deceptive solicitation support an ordinary rewards and promotions explanation, not an established fraudulent offer.
